Xiao Yu silently swept the fallen leaves in front of the woodshed, while several disciples gathered not far away, pointing at him without restraint.  

"Is this the same Xiao Yu who claimed to be the number one in the Mad Blade Sect? How did he end up living in the woodshed?"  

"You didn't know? He practiced some dark arts, messed up his qi, and now he's a cripple!"  

"I always said it—a bastard with no parents, barely trained in our sect, yet so strong? Turns out he took the crooked path! Disgrace to our Mad Blade Sect!"  

Xiao Yu cast a cold glance at the disciples. The imposing aura that once dominated the sect still lingered, silencing the cowards instantly. Just as he was about to resume his work, another unwelcome voice rang out:  

"Hmph, a broken-toothed hound still putting on a show, bullying fellow disciples?"  

Who else could it be but Song Baishu, the senior disciple of the Mad Blade Sect? The cowards hurried to flatter him, but Xiao Yu remained indifferent, sweeping the leaves.  

Song Baishu sneered, "You dare not bow when your senior brother arrives?"  

Xiao Yu replied coldly, "We are both disciples of the sect, equals. Besides, I’ve been expelled. Why should I bow to you?"  

In a flash, Song Baishu darted past the others, grabbing Xiao Yu’s face and slamming his head into the ground. Unable to resist, Xiao Yu coughed up blood from all orifices, a ghastly sight.  

"You think you can lecture me? Cripple?"  

Song Baishu wiped his hand with a handkerchief, then stepped on Xiao Yu’s head as if he were a stray dog.  

Already severely injured, Xiao Yu’s breath grew faint. His lips moved as if to speak. Curious, Song Baishu leaned in—only for Xiao Yu to spit blood in his face and laugh wildly.  

Enraged, Song Baishu was about to finish him off when a graceful figure rushed into the courtyard, shielding Xiao Yu. It was Wang Xun’er, the Sect Master’s daughter, who had just returned from buying medicine for Xiao Yu.  

"Junior Sister, why protect this traitor?"  

Wang Xun’er helped Xiao Yu up, her eyes blazing. "Xiao Yu and I are betrothed. How dare you harm him? Leave now, or I won’t hold back!"  

Song Baishu scowled. "The Sect Master annulled that betrothal. Why cling to this cripple? I’ll ask him to wed you to me instead!"  

As he spoke, Wang Xun’er reached for her sword, her killing intent locking onto him. Forced to retreat, Song Baishu feigned departure but suddenly lunged to knock her out. Xiao Yu, though powerless, still had sharp eyes and warned her just in time.  

Song Baishu dropped the act. "Xun’er, this traitor altered the Mad Blade techniques and leaked them! The Sect Master ordered his death. Why defy him?"  

Xiao Yu frowned—when had he done such a thing? Ignoring the accusations, Wang Xun’er grabbed his hand and fled toward the back mountain. The sect’s pursuit was relentless. Outnumbered, she fought as they retreated until they reached the cliff’s edge.  

The pursuers held back to avoid harming the Sect Master’s daughter, but blades were merciless—Wang Xun’er bore several cuts, and Xiao Yu’s injuries were far worse. The wind howled, fluttering his bloodstained robes.  

"Leave me here."  

Before Wang Xun’er could react, Xiao Yu leaped off the cliff. In his final moments, he understood everything. His shattered meridians were the Sect Master’s doing—his honest critique of the sect’s flawed techniques had sealed his fate.  

The Mad Blade Sect was unworthy of him. If there was a next life, he’d show that stagnant Sect Master what true martial arts looked like!
